applicabilityBasis.summary: JLTXX represents Token Class shares in a U.S. government money-market fund under the Investment Company Act of 1940, rather than a payment-stablecoin claim. GENIUS Act Section 2(22)(B)(iii) excludes securities under the 1933/1934/1940 Acts. Its proviso prevents a bond, note, evidence of indebtedness or investment contract issued by a permitted payment stablecoin issuer from becoming a security solely by satisfying Section 2(22)(A), consistent with Section 17. This fund-share assessment establishes excluded-security applicability, not GENIUS authorization; eligibility of fund assets as stablecoin reserves does not authorize JLTXX as a payment stablecoin.
